description: ACCDB: TB(ID PK, B BINARY(16)) and TV(ID PK, V VARBINARY(16)) with Null, empty byte[] (0 B), empty BSTR '', 1 B (0x00), 3 B (41 42 43), 4 B (41 42 43 00), 7 B, 8 B, 9 B (..08 00 and ..08 09), and 16 B (ff..f0); CREATE INDEX ASC and DESC on both tables, plus incremental insert. Keeps all pages before/after every step and Close; verifies Field metadata (Type/Size/Attributes), stored read-back, ORDER BY ASC/DESC, index walks, and Seek on ASC & DESC.

args.text: CREATE TABLE TB (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_TB PRIMARY KEY, B BINARY(16))
CREATE TABLE TV (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_TV PRIMARY KEY, V VARBINARY(16))
CREATE INDEX IX_BD ON TB (B DESC)
CREATE INDEX IX_VD ON TV (V DESC)
SELECT ID, B FROM TB ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, B FROM TB ORDER BY B ASC, ID ASC
SELECT ID, B FROM TB ORDER BY B DESC, ID ASC
SELECT ID, V FROM TV ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, V FROM TV ORDER BY V ASC, ID ASC
SELECT ID, V FROM TV ORDER BY V DESC, ID ASC
